entry.author: Northland Regional Council
entry.summary:
The Waiarohia journey continues to grow. Around 90 ākonga gathered at Whangārei Girls’ High School for a Climate Summit, exploring climate change, resilience and their connection to the Waiarohia catchment.

Since the summit, taiohi have continued the kaupapa through on-the-ground action. Students from Whangārei Boys’ High School recently carried out weeding mahi along the awa, removing invasive species and preparing sites for restoration.
